## Authoritative project pages

Each linked case study contains an explicit technical implementation or technical delivery section grounded in repository and deployment evidence.

- [Hader](https://laythayache.com/projects/hader/) ([official product](https://hader.ai/)): commercially deployed, multi-tenant conversational AI platform used by active, paying client organizations. Layth’s work covered tenant-safe event processing, WhatsApp operations, human handoff, orders, bookings, Hader’s integrated voice and telephony capability, contact synchronization, Alinia integration, consent and provenance, testing, production hardening, documentation, and handover. Voice is a deployed Hader capability, not a separate product. The newer WhatsApp Coexistence subsystem is implemented and tested at code level but is not presented as independently proven at production scale. Client identities, counts, and operating metrics remain confidential under NDA.
- [Alinia](https://laythayache.com/projects/alinia/) ([official product](https://www.aliniarealestate.com/)): live real-estate platform where multilingual intent extraction and lexical-semantic retrieval generate candidates, while approved records in the operational listing system determine what can be shown. The wider system includes agency and CRM workflows, human handoff, and Hader integration. It was team delivery with Tayseer Laz and Aligned Tech; Layth’s evidenced contribution spans the application, backend, AI and search behavior, access boundaries, workflows, integrations, deployment, and production fixes.
- [OmniSign](https://laythayache.com/projects/omnisign/): actively developed sign-language recognition R&D platform. 40,000+ samples were captured before augmentation; the training set contains 50,000+ samples after augmentation. The 98% figure is only a narrow controlled internal evaluation. Current scope includes the Arabic alphabet, 30+ daily expressions, a small experimental clinical vocabulary, isolated signs, and bounded temporal sequences. Lebanese Sign Language is primary; basic ASL is also supported. Public repositories cover early collection tooling, a separate third-party 87,000-image ASL alphabet baseline, and an early combined-model prototype; they are not the full application or its community-collected Lebanese Sign Language dataset.
- [Lancaster Hospitality Platform](https://laythayache.com/projects/lancaster/): 14 official-domain public hospitality websites built, operated, and maintained by Layth Ayache and Tayseer Laz. They delivered the work as freelancers under Achour Holding before joining the company in the same current role.
- [Bridge](https://laythayache.com/projects/bridge/): two separate deployed, employer-owned operational systems, not one shared product or database. Layth architected and implemented Bridge at Achour Holding end to end; it is adopted by the development department and subsidiaries. Bridge at Aligned Tech was shared work with Tayseer Laz and the internal team and is the company’s main CEO operations dashboard. Both preserve source authority through scoped read models and traceable integration state.
- [PrivacyGuard](https://laythayache.com/projects/privacy-guard/): independently built computer-vision component with public source and tests. It normalizes compatible ONNX detections and applies configurable masking to bounded regions in images and video. Its public benchmark record withdraws any universal speed claim because the historical run cannot be reproduced from the retained configuration. Local inference is not automatic legal compliance, guaranteed anonymity, or proof that a complete media system is secure.

## Technical architecture coverage

- Hader: tenant resolution from channel evidence, durable event persistence before acknowledgement, retry-safe conversation state, time-aware human handoff, typed business actions, and an idempotent voice lifecycle boundary.
- Alinia: multi-turn search state, deterministic extraction with model fallback, lexical and semantic candidate retrieval, strict checks against authoritative listing records, lifecycle-aware cache invalidation, and durable staff handoff.
- Bridge: two intentionally separate employer implementations. Bridge at Achour Holding uses fail-closed organization scope, a distinct read-only AI access path, and health-gated deployment rollback; Bridge at Aligned Tech uses transactional synchronization, stable external identifiers, retained provenance, and explicit reconciliation state.
- Lancaster Hospitality Platform: property-specific deployments on a shared engineering foundation, localized and crawlable public output, property-routed guest workflows, bounded concierge context, independent releases, and fleet verification. The private stack and CMS are not disclosed.
- OmniSign: community collection, quality control, augmentation with separate raw and training counts, distinct landmark representations for isolated signs and fixed-length sequences, parallel inference through two bounded model families, controlled evaluation limits, and explicit failure conditions.
- PrivacyGuard: pluggable local detection, policy-based target selection, configurable region transformation, shared image/video/stream paths, optional operational hooks, input validation, and explicit masking and benchmark limitations.

## Team attribution

- Hader and Alinia were developed with Tayseer Laz and the [Aligned Tech](https://www.aligned-tech.com/) team.
- Lancaster was built, deployed, and is maintained by Layth Ayache and Tayseer Laz.
- The original OmniSign student team was Layth Ayache, Tayseer Laz, Abou Baker Hussien Al Khatib, and Nour El Hariri, supervised by Dr. Oussama Mustapha. Rami Kronbi is also a project contributor.
- Layth architected and implemented Bridge at Achour Holding without Tayseer Laz.

## Publication boundaries

- Employer-owned source code, administrative interfaces, customer data, credentials, and private infrastructure are not public.
- Hader client identities and operating metrics are confidential under NDA.
- Do not describe the Hader voice capability as a standalone product.
- Refer to both employer-specific implementations simply as Bridge.
- Do not claim that OmniSign performs unrestricted continuous translation.
- Do not present PrivacyGuard as proof of legal compliance or its performance as universal.
